ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV Rust encryptor execution via unique --access-token CLI argument
ucs.description: Detects launch of the ALPHV/BlackCat (Noberus) Rust-based encryptor by its mandatory --access-token <64-char-hex> argument used to derive the encryption key, plus the actor-unique flags (--paths, --propagated, --no-prop-servers, --no-vm-kill, --safeboot). These switches are documented across Microsoft, Mandiant and CISA writeups as required by the BlackCat binary and are not used by any benign tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-snapshot-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--safeboot-instance*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | eval blackcat_match=if(match(process,"(?i)--access-token\s+[0-9a-f]{64}") OR (match(process,"(?i)--paths\s") AND match(process,"(?i)--no-prop")) OR match(process,"(?i)--safeboot(-network|-instance)?\b"),1,0) | where blackcat_match=1 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV encryptor command-line signature
let BlackCatFlags = dynamic(["--access-token","--no-prop-servers","--no-vm-snapshot-kill","--no-vm-mount-data-detection","--safeboot-instance","--safeboot-network","--propagated"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (BlackCatFlags)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts
| extend HasToken = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[0-9a-f]{64}"
| extend HasPropPair = ProcessCommandLine has "--paths" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--no-prop","--propagated")
| where HasToken or HasPropPair                  // either a 64-hex access token OR the --paths + propagation combo
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, MD5,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          HasToken, HasPropPair
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV encryptor command-line signature (Windows Security 4688)
let BlackCatFlags = dynamic(["--access-token","--no-prop-servers","--no-vm-snapshot-kill","--no-vm-mount-data-detection","--safeboot-instance","--safeboot-network","--propagated"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has_any (BlackCatFlags)
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend HasToken = CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[0-9a-f]{64}"
| extend HasPropPair = CommandLine has "--paths" and CommandLine has_any ("--no-prop","--propagated")
| where HasToken or HasPropPair
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = strcat(SubjectDomainName, "\\", SubjectUserName),
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName,
          HasToken, HasPropPair
| order by TimeGenerated desc

references:

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.impact

  - attack.t1027.009
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|re|i: '--access-token\s+[0-9a-f]{64}'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--paths'
      - '--no-prop'
  selection_safeboot:

      - '--safeboot-instance'
      - '--safeboot-network'
      - '--no-vm-snapshot-kill'
      - '--no-vm-mount-data-detection'
  condition: selection_token or selection_flags or selection_safeboot
falsepositives:
  - None known — these argument combinations are unique to ALPHV/BlackCat encryptor binaries.

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop-servers* OR @CommandLine:*--no-vm-snapshot-kill* OR @CommandLine:*--safeboot-instance* OR @CommandLine:*--propagated*)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV pre-encryption exfil chain — rclone.exe → mega.nz from a server host
ucs.description: Detects the BlackCat affiliate playbook of staging then exfiltrating data with rclone.exe to MEGA cloud storage 24–72h before deploying the encryptor. Microsoft, Mandiant (UNC4466) and CrowdStrike consistently attribute this rclone-to-MEGA exfil pattern (along with the ExMatter tool) to ALPHV affiliates including former BlackMatter/DarkSide operators and SCATTERED SPIDER (Microsoft: Octo Tempest) who joined the BlackCat program in 2023.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process="*rclone*") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" OR Processes.process="*copy*" OR Processes.process="*sync*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where match(mvjoin(cmdlines," "),"(?i)(mega:|mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|mega\.io|--transfers\s+\d|--multi-thread-streams)") | join type=left dest [| tstats `summariesonly` count as net_count values(All_Traffic.dest_host) as dest_hosts from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.io") by All_Traffic.src | rename All_Traffic.src as dest | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")`] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV exfil — rclone.exe pushing to MEGA cloud (within 30 min of network egress)
let Window = 30m;
let RcloneProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
         or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rclone.exe")
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\brclone(\.exe)?\b"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move","lsd")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--config")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              RcloneCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RcloneHash = SHA256,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let MegaEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteUrl endswith "mega.nz"
         or RemoteUrl endswith "mega.co.nz"
         or RemoteUrl endswith "mega.io"
         or RemoteUrl endswith "userstorage.mega.co.nz"
         or RemoteUrl endswith "g.api.mega.co.nz"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
RcloneProcs
| join kind=inner MegaEgress on DeviceName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', NetTime, ProcTime)) <= 30        // co-occurring within 30 min
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastSeen = max(ProcTime),
            BytesIndicator = count(), Destinations = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            DestIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25), Cmd = any(RcloneCmd), ParentImg = any(ParentImage)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat/ALPHV exfil — rclone.exe to MEGA via ASIM tables (vendor-portable)
let Window = 30m;
let RcloneProcs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where TargetProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\rclone\.exe$"
         or TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\brclone(\.exe)?\b"
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move")
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--config")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              RcloneCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine;
let MegaEgress = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega.co.nz","g.api.mega.co.nz")
           or DstHostname has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io")
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, Url, DstHostname, DstIpAddr;
RcloneProcs
| join kind=inner MegaEgress on DvcHostname
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', NetTime, ProcTime)) <= 30
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastSeen = max(ProcTime),
            Destinations = make_set(coalesce(Url, DstHostname), 25),
            Cmd = any(RcloneCmd), Parent = any(ParentProcessName)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*rclone*)) @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *--transfers* OR *--multi-thread-streams*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR regex("\\brclone(\\.exe)?\\b", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(copy|sync|move)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("mega:|mega\\.nz|mega\\.co\\.nz|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| join(query={#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|mega\.io)$/i | groupBy([aid], function=count(as=mega_dns))}, field=aid, include=[mega_dns])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function={count(as=hits) | min(@timestamp, as=first) | max(@timestamp, as=last)})
| hits > 0
ucs.rationale: rclone.exe is the BlackCat affiliate exfil tool of record — Microsoft's BlackCat report names it explicitly, Mandiant's UNC4466 writeup ties the rclone-to-MEGA pattern to a primary affiliate, and CISA AA23-353A lists the same combo. The MEGA destination (vs Dropbox/AnyDrive used by other RaaS) narrows the signature further — historically tied to BlackMatter/DarkSide → ALPHV operator continuity. Pa
